ns2:section.sectionText: Expanded title: History and Techniques of Letterpress Printing. Meets for two weeks during SS2, June 21 - July 2, with main location being the Soybean Press (Printing Services Bldg, 54 E. Gregory, Champaign) and occasionally at the Rare Book & Manuscripts Library (Room 346 Main Library). The first class meeting (6/21) will be held at the Soybean Press location; subsequent location schedule will be announced in class. [Elective course for Graduate Certificate in Special Collections (see http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/programs/mbms/certificate1). Departmental approval required to enroll. Contact Marianne Steadley (steadley@illinois.edu).] See section description at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog. A $40 course materials fee (non-waived) will be assessed to the tuition/fees bill.
